subject: MSBA Repair Applications and FY26 Budget
overview: The Medford School Committee approved submitting Accelerated Repair Statements of Interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority for three elementary schools and reviewed a preliminary fiscal year 2026 budget presentation.

items.title: MSBA Accelerated Repair Statements of Interest
items.summary: Approved three separate motions authorizing the administration to submit Statements of Interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority's Accelerated Repair Program for roof and heat pump replacements at Roberts, Misituck, and Brooks Elementary Schools.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Overview
items.summary: Budget Analyst Gerald McHugh presented preliminary details for the fiscal year 2026 budget, including enrollment projections, class sizes, revolving funds, and departmental funding requests.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining negotiations with school administrators and the Medford Teachers Association.
